title: Snow Diamond Dust Enchant Glint
description: This 1.15+ resource pack refreshes glint effect with a LightBlue color and SnowDust pattern. A simple texture replacement — no mods needed.
body:
ALYBH-RE Enchant Glint
-
Give glint effect a new look, Compatible with 1.15+ versions.  
The visual effects of this resource pack may differ slightly in versions below 1.19.4.  
After version 1.19.4, you can further customize the display effects of glint through the in-game accessibility settings, and this also applies to this resource pack.

✨Features
-
This resource pack replaces the glint effects with the following specific visual effects by replacing textures:
| Colors             | Patterns               | Effects              |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:|
|LightBlue, White            | Snow, Dust              | Color Transition             |
